restraints_config._comment: RGI RMSD restraint (JAX backend; the gpu flag is INERT for AF3 -- it always runs jax on the model's device, so use the JAX CPU platform to compute on CPU): drive the Kabsch-superposed RMSD of atom_selection_target toward target_rmsd vs a reference PDB (ref_pdb + atom_selection_ref); minimized by CG each step. Generate ref_pdb first (e.g. a vanilla AF3 prediction of this sequence converted to PDB via gemmi make_pdb_string) and save as rmsd_ref.pdb. RUN (partition af3): python run_alphafold.py --run_data_pipeline=False --model_dir=/home/apps/alphafold3/models --json_path=rmsd_example.json --output_dir=../out_af3_rmsd. Atoms pair by selection ORDER; the two selections MUST match in count (mismatch -> error). Selection DSL is chain/resid/index. AF3 rejects unknown top-level JSON keys, so notes live here ('_comment' is ignored by the parser).

rmsd_restraints_config._comment: Drive residues 90-180 to match the reference (RMSD -> 0). start_sigma optional (omit -> every step); weight optional (default 1.0).
